description: Counts reports in the FDA MAUDE database for a device (generic type or brand name) by reported outcome: malfunction, injury, death or other. Gives journalists, litigation researchers and patients a quick sense of the reporting record for a device type, with the essential caveat attached. Source: FDA MAUDE medical device reports via openFDA. Counts are of reports, not confirmed incidents or causes, and cannot be used to rank how safe devices are; it does not return individual report narratives. (cost: 1 credit)

device.description: string, required, device generic name or brand name, e.g. "insulin pump" or "Omnipod"

name: fda_device_problem_reports
